title: Montserrat, Lunch & Great Wine
text: We had a wonderful trip to Montserrat.  The lunch that followed was delicious and the visit to the winery was unique and informative.  It was also in a very idyllic setting.  Our guide Carlos was informative, knowledgeable, and a good friendly guy.  I'd recommend this trip and Carlos to anyone wanting a private tour.
author: Curious41464200524

title: Highly recommended
text: A great experience all around. Hernando picked us up at our hotel and we were on our way to Monserrat. He led us through the highlights then offered us a range of possibilities to explore from there. We chose the art museum and a short hike. The lunch afterwards was quite tasty and the winery was perfect as well. I was expecting only Cava but the winery offered a range of reds, whites, and rosés in addition to a fantastic Cava.
author: J5672UXrobertc

title: Montserrat and more
text: Exceptional experience.  This tour is already highly rated but it's beyond what you would expect.  Above and beyond is what they provide.  Our driver, Rafa, was conscientious and professional.  Our guide Feliciano was so personable and witty and charming.  He was a font of information about everything.  This tour's highlight for us was the winery visit which was just about as close to heaven as one can get.  We travelled through Spain for 3 weeks.  This was one of the top highlights.  We won't ever forget Feliciano or Rafa.
author: Teri_L

title: Just Book This!
text: We are so happy we booked this private all inclusive tour.  Our guide was amazing.  We happened to have him the evening before for another tour and he recommended to us to leave early for Monserrat. We arrived b4 all the tour buses and were able to be one of the first to see The Black Madonna and get pictures.  We lit 2 candles for loved ones that passed, had breakfast and Catalan Cheese.  The enjoyed an very filling Catalan lunch at a small unassuming restaurant and then enjoyed some very generous pours of wine tasting.  Well worth the price of our tour.  Would do it again. title: Barcelona Montserrat!
